title: jmap-vtc-ffmpeg: free-tools media backend (ffmpeg/GStreamer to static HLS)
description: Free-tools reference backend (docs/design/vtc-broadcast-research.md §po6q.5b): ffmpeg (or GStreamer) pushing to a static HLS/DASH origin, no DRM, no vendor. The only backend CI can run offline with real media (synthetic test source), so it is also the integration-test backend for the media hooks. Needs ffmpeg or GStreamer on the CI image (research open question); feature-gate the real-process tests.
close_reason: jmap-vtc-ffmpeg landed on main (cherry-pick of 989348e2); 29 tests pass, 3 real-ffmpeg tests behind feature + #[ignore] not run (no ffmpeg here)
